purpose: Positive control. Both pairs are VERIFIED with gold patches to produce a semantic integration failure: clean merge, A passes alone, B passes alone, B fails merged. This run asks whether the harness detects that end to end when AGENTS write the patches rather than the gold author.

task1.cause: JSON.parse('v2:[...]') throws once A prefixes the hash

task2.cause: TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property '0' -- A froze the array B reorders

required_result: Both patches pass alone, merge clean, combined tests fail, and the pair's edge recorded. If either is not detected end to end, STOP and report the harness gap; do not proceed to more episodes.

episodes.seeded_edge: utils.ts::hashKey return shape -> queryCache.ts parses query.queryHash
utils.ts::addToEnd/addToStart return frozen arrays -> infiniteQueryBehavior.ts reorders in place

structure_note: Both pairs are features of ONE task, so both episodes share one image. Split across two task ids, the disk guard reclaimed the image between episodes: it protects only the tags of the task about to run, and the second task had no tags yet.
